**God's Eye // UAP 2.6: 77 more cases from around the world, 251 in all, in 45 countries and territories.**

### ▶ [Open the live app](https://domw99.github.io/Gods-Eye-UAPs/)

Four researchers worked a region each, checked every case against its primary sources (Blue Book files, government archives, AARO and congressional releases, embassy cables, air-force rulings) and gave each the status its evidence supports. Many are explained or identified: re-entering rockets, launch plumes, balloons, Venus, meteors and hoaxes.

**United States (21)**: Blue Book's Long Beach F-86s (1951), Mitchel AFB (1952), the Salem Coast Guard photo and the Florida scoutmaster (1952), the cutter Sebago (1957), Captain Killian (1959), Redmond (1959), the Arrey theodolite (1949) and Carson Sink B-25 (1952), Farmington (1950), the 1965 Midwest wave, Malmstrom (1975), Lake Michigan (1994), America West 564 (1995), the 2018 FAA tapes; solved: the Aztec hoax (1948), the 2010 "mystery missile" contrail, the 2015 Trident test, the Long March 7 (2016) and Falcon 9 (2021) re-entries, and the Navy image shown to Congress that was drones (2022).

**Europe and the former Soviet Union (18)**: Tunguska (1908), the Sheerness airship (1912), Fátima (1917), the MoD's Flying Saucer Working Party on Farnborough (1950), the Portuguese F-84s (1957), the Solway Firth "spaceman" (1964), Ummo (1967), the 1967 saucer hoax, Billy Meier, four GEIPAN files (Gujan-Mestras, Pranles, Guipavas, Trancrainville), the Minsk Aeroflot crew (1984), the KGB's Kapustin Yar package (1989), Pereslavl-Zalessky (1990), the first crop circles' confession (1991) and Howden Moor (1997).

**Latin America (19)**: Barra da Tijuca (1952), Gravataí (1954), Trancas (1963), the lead masks (1966), Corporal Valdés (1977), Bermejo (1978), VASP 169 (1982), the Río de la Plata pilots (2005), Chile's El Bosque (2010), Santiago (2012) and Collahuasi (2013) files, Uruguay's CRIDOVNI rulings (2010, 2021), the Porto Alegre pilots (2022), the Chinese balloon over Colombia (2023), the "Nazca mummies" (2023), Espora (2023), the Long March plume the Argentine Air Force identified (2024) and Campo Largo (2026).

**Canada, Asia, Oceania, Africa and the Middle East (19)**: the 1909 New Zealand airship and 1914 South African monoplane scares, the Nowra Sea Fury (1954), CFS Falconbridge (1975), the Moroccan re-entry cables (1976), Kuwait's oil fields (1978), the 1981 China spiral, the McRoberts photo, Harbour Mille (2010), the Falcon 9 spirals over Australia (2010) and New Zealand (2022), the Temple Mount hoax (2011), Chelyabinsk (2013), the Naga fireballs, Jeffreys Bay (2016), the Long March 5B over Sarawak (2022), and AARO's Gulf of Oman (2021), UAE and Syria (2024) releases.
